race.comment: SOLAR SYSTEM (5) led them up last start over 1615m at Broome, running away to win by 3.3L. Gray remains on board and although he drops in trip, his form at the trip is solid. Rates highly on that performance and he can go on with the job. SHE IS ALL MAGIC (10) has improved her past couple, missing by 1.7L two back before a 0.3L defeat most recently at this track and trip. This shapes similarly and she's trending towards a drought breaking win. Ticks plenty of boxes. KIMBERLEY CURRENCY (2) stuck on well over shorter last time and getting out to 1200m again today is a big tick. Should be able to find a good spot in running and his best form makes him very appealing. MARS MISSION (3) can improve getting out in trip and the inside barrier suits. MYSTERY MINUTE (4) can bounce back to his best form.
